key_points: Problem: Incorrect bills from a defective rule change cause the dispute surge (E-06, E-03, E-11).
Establishment: Rose in dispute tickets (E-06), disputed bills by read type (E-03), and rule‑change hypothesis confirmed by high‑consumption rejections (E-11).
Release: Provides monitoring of bill accuracy (DA-BILL) and tracking of dispute volume (DA-TICKET) per solution design minimum useful scope (SD-1).

Decision: Gate resulted in CONDITIONAL_PASS because the release covers monitoring/tracking but omits the remedy to revert the defective rule change (semantic:addresses_root_problem failure) (PD-1), so we release with known limitations and defer the root‑cause fix as a VOB.
